verdicts.subject: Present-tense 'we beat the consensus'
verdicts.note: DECISION OF RECORD (no ruling doc): the cited retro only REPORTS the 2026 w1-6 gap to Sleeper (+0.093 MAE after the QB anchor; it also states the sealed-2025 -0.086) and does not itself ban landing-page wording; the ban on present-tense 'we beat the consensus' is recorded here on 2026-11-23. Dated backtest claims (a line with a year, 'sealed', 'backtest' or 'historical') stay allowed. Scope: frontend source and README.MD; docs/ is out of scope (docs/ACCURACY_COMPETITION.md quotes the dated 2022-24 result). Allowed by the 'unless' regex: code comments (definition of a negative gap) and the data-driven ternary pill label in accuracy-dashboard.tsx (win ? 'Beat Consensus' : 'Trailing'), which renders only when the live gap is negative; it is not static copy.

verdicts.subject: Sleeper anchor: the whole shipped config set and its override flags
verdicts.note: Pins the full SHIPPED_DEFAULT_CONFIGS tuple (positions, order, mode, weights; WR/RB/TE per SLEEPER_ANCHOR_QB_RB_TE_GATE.md, QB per the retro). A value change, an extra position or a cron-passed override neutralises the ship: --consensus-anchor-src REPLACES the whole shipped set (resolve_sleeper_anchor_configs), and the extra-* flags replace one position's config. TE weight 0.75 is NOT shipped.

verdicts.subject: Dispersion shrink factors
verdicts.note: Per-position k fitted leave-one-week-out on 2026 w1-9: QB/RB/TE 0.8, WR 1.0 (no shrink). SHRINK_FACTOR 0.8 is the base from the 2026-10-21 ship (retro). MIN_CENTRE_PTS 5.0 is the startable-pool cutoff described in CLAUDE.md; the fit doc does not restate it. --dispersion-shrink-k applies ONE k to every position and must never be in a cron.

verdicts.subject: Residual coverage guard threshold
verdicts.note: MIN_RATIO 0.70: skip a position's residual when serve-time feature coverage is under 70% of training. The cited doc says the guard stays quiet at 94-102% but does not fix the 0.70 value; no ruling doc for the number (recorded in the src comment and CLAUDE.md). MIN_RATIO 0.0 would silently disable the guard.

verdicts.subject: Lineup tool: our projections get zero weight
verdicts.note: No ruling doc for the fitted constants: the doc is the original plan (both-sources-agree-by-3.0 rule) that the fit superseded. The ruling is the replay sweep recorded in the src/lineup_setter.py comments (fit weeks 1-5, tested 6-9: every OURS_WEIGHT above 0.1 scored fewer actual points) and CLAUDE.md's lineup_setter row. Sleeper's projection under league scoring is the one estimate. CONSENSUS_FD_FROM_RATES False: did not score more lineup points, stays off.

verdicts.subject: Lineup tool: SWAP 0.52, no LEAN band, writer 0.60
verdicts.note: No ruling doc (see lineup-ours-weight-zero). SWAP_P 0.52 chosen on weeks 1-5 replay; LEAN_P == SWAP_P because the band just under the line lost points (P in [0.50,0.52): 15 pairs, 27% right, -43 pts); WRITE_P 0.60 because the ESPN writer acts and asks more. The argparse defaults of --swap-p/--lean-p/--write-p resolve through the imported constants and are pinned by value. The cron must never run the writer (--espn-write/--apply) or override a threshold.

verdicts.subject: Team-total constraint (--constrain)
verdicts.note: PROJECT.md lists 'game-level constraints (opt-in)' in the shipped milestone; MODEL_AUDIT_2026_06_12.md records that implied_totals loading is gated on --constrain. Neither doc rules on the default. State of record: default False and the cron does not pass it. OBSERVATION (not a violation of this entry): generate_projections.py loads implied totals only under --constrain, while the audit says live production always passes implied totals - worth a human check that the Vegas multiplier is not silently a no-op in the cron.

verdicts.subject: Game predictions use the shipped ensemble (--ensemble)
verdicts.note: --ensemble selects the shipped XGB+LGB+CB+Ridge ensemble (models/ensemble/) instead of the v1.4 single model; it is NOT an operational flag. ENSEMBLE_HEALTH keeps the shipped ensemble; it does not rule on the flag itself. Dropping it from the cron silently publishes the old model.

verdicts.subject: No unreviewed flag passthrough into publishers
verdicts.note: DECISION OF RECORD (no ruling doc): that doc states the cron command is 'generate_projections.py --ml with no opt-ins'. A ${{ inputs.* / vars.* }} expansion or an unlisted shell variable on a publisher command line can inject any flag past the token scan, so each must be allowlisted with a reason.
